name: teamchat-socket-provider
description: TeamChat as a chat provider: the host holds a gateway socket for each connected workspace and every new message becomes a chat-message record. Workflows can pick rooms (chat.channels) and reply in a thread (chat.reply). Setup is pasted: create the TeamChat app from the bundled definition, then paste its gateway token and API token.
author: Acme Chat

credentials.label: Gateway token
credentials.help: App settings → Gateway → Create token. Papercusp uses it only to open the gateway socket.

credentials.label: API token
credentials.help: App settings → Install to workspace, then copy the API token.

appRegistration.copyHint: New app → From a definition → paste this JSON.

definition.name: Papercusp
definition.description: Brings messages from the rooms you add it to into Papercusp, and replies in their threads.
